等待本地人物、有效相机和新鲜同源数据后才能确认视角: A view can only be confirmed with fresh local character and camera data from the same source
只使用 Reader 明确提供的敌我关系。未分类人物和本地人物不作为目标；当前: Only explicit Reader relationships select targets. Unknown and local characters are excluded. Life state is unavailable, so bodies cannot be filtered automatically.
检查本机配置的游戏进程。Reader 在远端时可关闭此检查；远端前台状态不会被假: Checks the configured local game executable. Disable for a remote game; remote foreground state remains unknown.
分别检查位置、骨骼和相机从采样到当前的年龄；缺失、过期、时钟对齐不可用或三流时间: Checks the age of positions, skeletons and camera independently. Missing, stale, unaligned or widely separated samples pause tracking.
手动设置的输出响应时间模型，用来扣除尚未反映到相机的已提交位移；不是硬件实测值，: An explicit response-time model accounts for submitted motion not yet reflected in the camera. It is not a hardware measurement or a target-velocity estimate.
填写当前游戏设置下，每个正鼠标计数引起的有符号角度变化。0 表示未知，未填写两轴: Enter signed angular changes per positive mouse count for the current game settings. Zero is unknown and prevents output. Recheck after sensitivity or zoom changes; these are not native Reader coefficients.
正鼠标计数为向右，正水平角为向右；如横轴反向，应填写负值。: Positive mouse counts and positive yaw both point right. Use a negative value for an inverted horizontal axis.
正鼠标计数为向下，正俯仰角为抬头，因此普通纵轴通常填写负值。请使用自己的换算结果: Positive vertical mouse counts point down, while positive pitch points up. A normal vertical axis usually needs a negative value. Use your own measured conversion.
按住侧键后保持同一目标，短暂缺帧或部位缺失时暂停并等待恢复。使用头、颈、胸或骨盆: Holding the side button retains one target and pauses for missing samples or joints. Tracks current head, neck, chest or pelvis joints without inferring Hitboxes or cover.
0 表示不限距离，按相机到目标骨点的原生世界单位计算。: Zero disables the distance limit. Distance uses native world units from camera to target joint.
Reader 尚未提供相机归属与可控状态。请只在本地第一人称、自己可以控制视角时: The Reader does not provide view ownership or controllability. Confirm only your controllable local first-person view. Confirmation belongs to the current connections, Reader session and local character. Revoke it when spectating, dead or switching view modes.
等待本地人物、骨骼和透视相机: Waiting for local character, skeletons and perspective camera
等待已确认的本地人物: Waiting for an identified local character
请确认当前相机为本地可控视角: Confirm a controllable local camera view
请填写非零的横纵角度/鼠标计数: Enter nonzero signed degrees per mouse count on both axes
等待同一Reader与会话的数据: Waiting for data from the same Reader and session
等待新鲜数据和可信时钟对齐: Waiting for fresh samples and clock alignment
三路采样时间差过大，等待接近的采样: Waiting for closer observation times across the three streams
当前相机不可用于跟随: The current camera cannot be used for tracking
等待角差范围内所选部位的骨点: Waiting for the selected joint within the aim cone
本次锁定的目标暂不可用: The held target is temporarily unavailable
等待本次锁定的目标恢复: Waiting for the held target to return
采样顺序异常，等待新采样: Sample order is invalid; waiting for a fresh observation
等待相机角度响应，恢复后继续同一目标: Waiting for camera response before continuing the held target
等待相机反馈消化已提交位移: Waiting for camera feedback to include submitted movement
正在按手动换算跟随所选骨点: Tracking the selected joint with manual coefficients
